name: Peggy — Deep fact re-check (thin-source QDE rows)

parameters.formDescription: Re-researches QDE_Post_Queue rows with a deep web-research model. Leave the box empty to re-check every blank-status row whose sources came back thin (max 5 per run). Or type post IDs like 43, 45, 48. It only rewrites the fact_status, facts_need_verify and notes columns. It never changes status, the headline, or the caption — suggested copy fixes go to Slack and notes for a human. Results post to Slack #qde-celebrity-post-review.

values.placeholder: 43, 45, 48   — or leave empty for all thin-source rows

values.formSubmittedText: Started. Deep research takes several minutes per story. Results land in the sheet (columns N, O and notes) and post to Slack #qde-celebrity-post-review.
